runtime/network#

The native layer under net/dns, net/multicast, net/stream, net/tcp: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under net/dns, net/multicast, net/stream, net/tcp: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Private native substrate for Stage 20 networking. SocketState is an opaque, runtime-owned capability. Every state created here is non-blocking; public net/* modules never expose this object or its numeric family/type protocol.

native udp_bound#

native udp_bound(address is @byte, zone is string, reuse is bool, broadcast is bool, dual_stack is bool) is SocketState

Atomic nonblocking UDP acquisition: configure options before binding and close every unpublished descriptor on failure. Numeric endpoint envelope comes from runtime/net.ip_parse; scoped IPv6 lookup uses AI_NUMERICHOST/AI_NUMERICSERV. local_endpoint returns [numeric address, decimal port, decimal scope or ""]. Handles remain opaque; closed() is an observation of their shared tombstone.

native udp_receive#

native async udp_receive(origin is SocketState, limit is int) is @byte

One ordinary UDP packet, with a fixed native receive buffer <= 65536 bytes. The private versioned envelope preserves source scope, prefix and truncation. Cancellation removes readiness; close wakes the pending receive.

native udp_send#

native async udp_send(origin is SocketState, target is @byte, zone is string, payload is @byte) is int

Submit exactly one ordinary UDP packet; success is the full payload count. IP limits are checked before the host call; host EMSGSIZE uses the operation's message_too_large code. No retry of a short result, no splitting or DNS.

native udp_connect#

native async udp_connect(origin is SocketState, target is @byte, zone is string) is bool

Connection acquisition uses an unpublished owned state. Connect is one-shot; its cancellation or host failure closes that state. Connected packet actions cannot override the peer, and unconnected packet actions reject this state.

native multicast_join#

native multicast_join(origin is SocketState, group is @byte, name is string, index is int, hops is int, loopback is bool) is MembershipState

Synchronous any-source membership acquisition on an existing UDP owner. First success pins multicast send settings; failed acquisition rolls back. Socket close ends memberships; later membership close is idempotent.

native unix_path_valid#

native unix_path_valid(origin is @byte) is bool

No I/O: reject empty/NUL/overlong filesystem paths before host packing. Capacity is host-specific and reserves a terminating NUL. The provider's private sockaddr helper must be reused by future Unix bind/connect actions.
